A_proposed_calibration_arms.objective: Repair probability calibration for the ratings + doctrine + structure core without letting market information recrowd or dominate the model.

arms.name: core_uncalibrated_baseline
arms.purpose: Reference point for pure ratings + doctrine + structure behavior.

arms.name: core_isotonic_no_market
arms.purpose: Repair calibration using validation-only isotonic on core scores without any market inputs.

arms.name: core_platt_no_market
arms.purpose: Test logistic/Platt calibration on core scores only.

arms.name: core_temperature_scaling_no_market
arms.purpose: Apply one-parameter confidence scaling to reduce overconfidence without changing ranking.

arms.name: core_jurisdiction_aware_calibration_no_market
arms.purpose: Allow HK/FR-specific calibration on core scores only if validation support is adequate.

arms.name: core_market_aware_calibration_guardrailed
arms.purpose: Optional market-aware calibration-side metadata experiment with strict recrowding gates and no raw market feature learning in the core.
allowed_inputs: bounded market metadata for post-core calibrator only
arms.market_usage: calibration-side metadata only under isolation limits

arms.name: core_residual_confidence_dampening
arms.purpose: Shrink extreme core probabilities toward race-level neutrality without using raw market features.

arms.name: core_conservative_probability_shrinkage
arms.purpose: Apply conservative post-hoc shrinkage to improve calibration while preserving the core ranking signal.

allowed_inputs: bounded market metadata for post-core calibrator only
core_market_aware_calibration_guardraile.market_usage: calibration-side metadata only under isolation limits

rules: Calibration arm must not degrade core log loss by more than 0.01.
Calibration arm must not degrade core Brier by more than 0.0025.
Calibration ECE must improve relative to the current core.
HK must remain non-negative vs market on log loss.
FR must remain positive vs market on log loss.
Market probability correlation must stay at or below 0.58.
Top-1 market overlap must stay at or below 0.45.
No leakage, no outcome fields, no prior model outputs, no production writes.

authority_model.known_caveat: direct runner_results join has legacy horse-id drift and is not the authority for Playbook G V2 training cohort.

repair_requirements: Calibrators train on validation years only.
No label leakage through market-derived outcome surrogates.
No use of prior model outputs.

guardrails: Market cannot appear in the core feature mask.
Any market-aware arm must report market correlation and top-1 overlap explicitly.
Any arm that crosses either isolation threshold is rejected regardless of headline log loss.
Residual-learning over market must be treated as an optional diagnostic, not a default path.

requirements: Evaluate HK and FR separately for every calibration arm.
HK must stay improved or at least non-negative vs market.
FR must stay positive vs market.
JPN remains informational only until sample size improves.

policy: Primary go/no-go should be based on full out-of-time test and separately reviewed 2023-2024.
2025 may veto a calibration arm only if it also harms 2023-2024 or materially breaks calibration.

sequence: Run core uncalibrated baseline as immutable reference.
Test non-market calibrators first: isotonic, Platt, temperature, conservative shrinkage.
Run jurisdiction-aware non-market calibration only if validation support is adequate.
Only after non-market arms are evaluated, optionally test strict market-aware calibration metadata arm.
Reject any arm that trips the recrowding gates even if headline metrics improve.
I_recommended_execution_plan.best_starting_point: temperature scaling or conservative shrinkage on the core, because both can improve calibration with lower risk of reintroducing market dependence.
I_recommended_execution_plan.next_approved_mission: Review this calibration-repair design, then approve or reject offline calibration-repair execution.

J_whether_calibration_repair_execution_i.reason: The core has enough signal and stability to justify calibration repair research, but only under strict market-isolation gates and without any production writes.

core_candidate_review.label: accept V3 core as offline research candidate only
core_candidate_review.reason: The suite failed for governance reasons, not because the core was weak. The ratings+doctrine+structure core is now strong enough to be treated as an offline research candidate, while market-assisted variants remain rejected.

stability_recommendation.label: accept core as offline research candidate only
stability_recommendation.reason: The core is promising, but uncertainty remains wide enough that calibration work should wait until stability is clearer.
